name: Bubble Trouble
author: Addicting Games
description:
The original arcade classic that started it all - pure, addictive bubble-popping action with simple controls and increasingly challenging levels.
Bubble Trouble is a retro-style arcade shooter where you play as a devil in a trench coat armed with a spike gun. Pop bouncing bubbles that split into smaller, faster threats with each hit. Dodge and shoot your way through increasingly chaotic levels, clearing the screen before the bubbles overwhelm you. Quick reflexes are your best weapon!
